# Stephen Irving

## Overview

- **Age:** middle age  <sub>[v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P22](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0022)</sub>
- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P22](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0022)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Family:** [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) (spouse)

## Appearance

Stephen Irving is a tall, handsome man of middle age with iron-gray hair and deep-set, dark blue eyes. His strong, sad face features splendid modeling about the chin and brow.

_Sources: [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P22](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0022)_

## Personality

Stephen Irving is a high-strung and sensitive individual who possesses a proud disposition. He is also remembered as a reserved man, though it is believed he guards a deep and tender nature beneath his guarded exterior.

_Sources: [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P8](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0008), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P19](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0019)_

## History

Stephen Irving originally went into business with his uncle in the United [States](../codex/places.md#states) and married a [Yankee](../codex/factions.md#yankee), though he had previously suffered a broken engagement with Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md). Years later, his son [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) formed a warm connection with Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), leading [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) to assist when Stephen returned to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) seeking to reconnect with his former love. Upon arriving at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge), Stephen reunited and reconciled with Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), and the pair were subsequently married in a garden ceremony before departing together at the station.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P47](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0047), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P2](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0002), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P3](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0003), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P6](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0006), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P9](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0009), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P11](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0011), +148 more_

## Quotes

> "In Paul’s last letter he spoke of going with you to visit an old . . . friend of mine . . . Miss Lewis at the stone house in Grafton. Do you know her well?"
>
> — Stephen Irving — [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P30](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0030)

> "Yes, I believe you are. Well, I am going to ask a favor of you. I would like to go and see Miss Lavendar if she will let me. Will you ask her if I may come?"
>
> — Stephen Irving — [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P35](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0035)

> "There is nothing changed about this house or garden since I was here twenty-five years ago. It makes me feel young again."
>
> — Stephen Irving — [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P60](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0060)

> "I hardly knew my boy, he had grown so big and brown and sturdy."
>
> — Stephen Irving — [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P27](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0027)

> "So this is my little son’s ‘beautiful teacher,’ of whom I have heard so much"
>
> — Stephen Irving — [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P23](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0023)

## Relationships

### [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/lavendar-lewis--stephen-irving.md)

Stephen Irving and [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) were originally engaged twenty-five years prior, but their relationship ended in a broken engagement. After Stephen expressed a desire to reconnect, the two reunited at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) with the assistance of [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md). Their long-standing romance was fully revived, culminating in a garden wedding where they were married in front of their friends.

- Romantically involved with — formerly engaged twenty-five years ago  <sub>[v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P36](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0036), [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P9](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0009), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P22](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0022)</sub>
- Spouse of — married in a ceremony  <sub>[v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P30](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0030)</sub>

### [Anne](../character/anne.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne--stephen-irving.md)

[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) is an acquaintance and friend of Stephen Irving who played a key role in rekindling his romance with Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md). Upon learning that Stephen wished to reconnect with his former love, [Anne](../character/anne.md) excitedly helped arrange their reunion at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) and prepared Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) for his arrival. She subsequently assisted with the wedding preparations and saw the couple off after their ceremony.

- Friend of — acquaintance who helped bring about his marriage (since v3)  <sub>[v3 ch.Philippa P9](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0009)</sub>
